intro.title: Rotate Array
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that rotates the elements of an array by a specified number of positions to the right. You will learn the core programming concept of array manipulation, including how to handle edge cases like large rotation counts. The main technologies involved are JavaScript arrays and basic control structures like loops. By the end, you will understand how to efficiently shift elements within an array while maintaining their order.
intro.usecase: The rotate array pattern is essential in UI components that display rotating content, such as image carousels, news tickers, or dashboard widgets that cycle through metrics. In e-commerce platforms, product galleries use array rotation to showcase different views of an item when users click navigation arrows. Developers implement this algorithm to efficiently manage circular buffers in media players, where playlists rotate continuously, or in notification systems that display messages in a loop without requiring constant data reloads.
